name: Carpenter Chartered
body:
Stage

Exploratory. First call complete. Decision-maker engaged but no advisor role earned yet.

Next move

Send tailored Plus One pricing variant. Frame around their off-season throughput, not their busy-season scramble.

Watch

They are price-shopping three other firms. Differentiation is advisor frame plus speed of response.

name: Mediafly Plus One
body:
Stage

Pricing finalized. Contract drafted. Waiting on legal review their side.

Next move

Day-of meeting prep skill should fire 24 hours before next sync. Pull their last three call summaries into the briefing.

Risk

Low. Sponsor is internal champion. Procurement cycle is the only friction.

name: Wave Energy Services
body:
Stage

Signature pending 21 days. This is the longest unsigned contract in the pipeline right now.

Next move

Call decision-maker. Do not send another email. The friction is internal politics, not pricing.

Risk

High. Every additional week reduces close probability roughly fifteen points.

name: Hansen Rosasco
body:
Status

Closed won April 15. First retainer invoice sent.

Expansion lever

They mentioned a sister firm twice on the kickoff. Warm intro is on the table after Q2.

Next move

Quarterly business review scheduled June. Use it to seed the referral conversation, not request it.

name: GME Supply
body:
Status

Active engagement. Monthly check-in cadence.

Watch

Their internal marketing hire starts in June. Either an expansion opportunity or a churn risk depending on how that lands.

name: EnSight Tech
body:
Status

Active. Mid-engagement, two months in on a six-month scope.

Next move

Run the Hüify skills audit against their team in week ten. They asked for it directly.

name: CasePacer
body:
Status

Renewal closed April 10. Second-year terms with expanded scope.

Note

Lower priority because the relationship runs itself. Touch quarterly.

name: Plus One Pricing Model
body:
What it is

The pricing scaffolding behind every Plus One deal. Three tiers, one anchor, no menu of features.

How to deploy

Always lead with the second tier. The first tier exists only to make the second look reasonable. The third tier exists only to be referenced once.

Used by

Carpenter Chartered, Mediafly, Wave Energy Services.

name: Advisor Frame Rule
body:
The rule

Earn the advisor seat before pitching. No proposal goes out before the prospect has used the word advisor about you, unprompted.

Why

Vendor frame compresses pricing power. Advisor frame expands it. The same scope of work commands forty percent more revenue from an advisor seat.

How to test

Listen for the language they use to describe you to internal stakeholders. If they say partner or advisor, you are in. If they say vendor or agency, slow down.

name: Don't Recreate User Actions
body:
The rule

If a human action exists, do not have AI redo it. Capture the human action, route it through the brain, build leverage from that.

Application

Call wraps. Meeting recaps. Email replies. The user already did the thinking. The system's job is to extract, route, and remember, not to regenerate from scratch.

name: Hüify Skills Audit
body:
Purpose

Living inventory of every skill the Hüify team can deploy, who can deploy it, and what trigger pulls it.

Cadence

Reviewed monthly. Every new skill enters here before it ships into a client engagement.

name: Brain-Sync Skill v2
body:
What it does

Syncs the federated identity brain across surfaces. Pushes new nodes and edges into the cockpit on a 3am cron and on demand.

Inputs

Markdown files in josh-identity. Frontmatter required: type, scope, department, priority, status, last_activity, tags.

Outputs

nodes.json and edges.json in this site's data folder. Activity log entry per change.

name: Call-Wrap Skill
body:
What it does

After every call, captures the human's three-line summary, routes the structured output to the relevant node in the brain, and links action items into the right place.

Why it matters

Twenty calls a week, ninety seconds of capture each, two thousand minutes of recall recovered per quarter.

name: Forge Cockpit
body:
This site

You are inside it right now. Graph-as-home navigation for the federated identity brain.

Why graph

Folders are how you store information. Graphs are how you remember it. The brain is a graph; the navigation should be too.

Phase 2

Three.js depth, wormhole transitions, voice nav, AI-suggested latent edges.

name: Three Hüify Properties
body:
The three

Speed of response. Advisor frame. Skill-based delivery.

How they show up

Every piece of marketing collateral leans on one of the three. Never more than one per piece. Never zero.

name: Day-of Meeting Prep
body:
What it does

Twenty-four hours before any external meeting, assembles a one-page brief: who, last touch, open threads, three opener questions.

Trigger

Calendar event with external attendee. Skill fires automatically at 24h, again at 1h.

name: Forge Identity Architecture
body:
The architecture

Two repositories. josh-identity holds personal context, opinions, rules. huify-identity (when it exists) will hold company-level context. Cockpit federates both.

Frontmatter contract

Every markdown node carries: id, name, type, scope, department, priority, status, last_activity, tags. Edges live in markdown links between files plus an explicit edges.yaml for non-textual relationships.

name: Plus One MMO Gamification
body:
The idea

Treat Plus One delivery like an MMO. Each engagement is a raid. Each skill is a class. Each client is a guild.

Why it might work

The team already plays this way informally. Naming it would compound it.

Why it might not

Cute concepts can collapse into cringe quickly. Test on internal channels first.
